value.rationale: The exact minimal-period classification solves the all-prime structural question naturally arising from a published conjectural period table for this weighted partition statistic. A precise pole-cancellation explanation distinguishes small primes and establishes the whole p>=7 family beyond any finite table. This is a natural invariant, not a merely arbitrary coefficient check.
